headline: Pierrakakis: Triple intervention in September on income, private debt and investment
summary: Greek Minister of National Economy and Finance Kyriakos Pierrakakis said September will bring significant decisions on income, private debt and investment. The measures will affect the economy and citizens' daily lives.
why: Fiscal and debt measures from Greece's finance ministry influence government bond yields and the outlook for domestic demand and investment.
